messages:
deploy-bot: Canary started for rdx-runtime v2.3.1 -> 10% traffic. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/rdx-runtime-v2.3.1 :rocket:
ana: I'm release lead for this change window 16:00-17:00 UTC. Monitoring metrics and support channel. Runbook link: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/backout-playbook (sec 3 has rollback commands).
mike: Quick ops checklist posted to #eng-oncall. Alerts on for errors/latency. Backout trigger we agreed: error_rate > 1% sustained for 3m OR p95 > 200ms for 5m.
liam: Change is small: kernel selector tweak + KV cache default TTL bump. Watch for memory pressure on the VM and any OOMs in pods.
tina_ops: Who will execute rollback if triggered? Need a named executor.
mike: I'll take the revert run. Command (from runbook): ```redwoodctl deploy revert --service rdx-runtime --to v2.3.0 --reason "canary-failure"```
oncall-bot: Alert policy armed: canary-error-rate-policy (1% / 3m) -> pages to #eng-oncall and oncall pager.
nana: Add escalation: if GPU queueing delay rises >30% for 10m, consider backout prep. That's been a leading indicator.
liam: Confirmed. I'll watch kernel logs and KV cache eviction spikes and post updates.
mike: Dry-run of revert OK: ```redwoodctl deploy revert --service rdx-runtime --to v2.3.0 --dry-run``` -> no blockers.
nana: Backout steps summary (from runbook): 1) quorum = release lead + oncall + runtime lead, 2) run revert on primary region, 3) pin model variants on stable routes if needed, 4) validate metrics return to baseline, 5) run postmortem and update release notes.
tina_ops: Oncall to hold pager and confirm rollback window. If we revert, I'll post a customer-facing note draft.
liam: Noting a small GPU queue spike at ts=4849123478 (+15%). Not worried yet.
mike: Canary at 20% now (observability shows stable p50/p95). No errors.
nana: Good. Keep thread alive for any signals — we'll escalate here first. :thumbsup:
